accounting_summary.union_caution: Union is a spelling inventory across alternate readings of one physical paragraph, not independent evidence.

unscorable_capacity.distinction: UNSCORABLE is inherited source capacity, not a rejected meaning, missing row, or an inability to author an explicit conditional C0 alternate.

objective_validator_fields.check: Exact equality to pinned source for every row; one row per raw ID, ordered by reader/locus/native index.
objective_validator_fields.limit: Does not establish word meanings or sentence scope.

objective_validator_fields.check: Every used form resolves to a declared dictionary record; repeated spelling has one stable value or an explicitly declared finite typed overload; overload declarations and usage can be enumerated.
objective_validator_fields.limit: A declared condition is not evidence that a manuscript occurrence has that condition; arbitrary semantic renaming can evade superficial matching.

objective_validator_fields.check: Declared IDs exist; arity/types match explicit declarations; argument references resolve to prior introduced objects or explicitly priced forward binding; output references are unique and their recorded use can be traced.
objective_validator_fields.limit: Free prose arguments are not machine-checkable meanings. Matching declared types does not establish actual manuscript participants.

objective_validator_fields.check: Exact ordered raw substrings concatenate to the unchanged whole; every whole residual and context condition has a finite declared ID and recorded use.
objective_validator_fields.limit: String concatenation is not proven morpheme segmentation or semantic composition; no automatic null-part inference.

objective_validator_fields.check: Nonempty row fields and explicit UNKNOWN/BLOCKED states; every introduced output has a recorded consumer or declared final retained object; unmatched/unconsumed IDs can be listed.
objective_validator_fields.limit: A prose claim of consumption cannot be accepted as proof. A blocked row is accounted for but cannot satisfy complete content construction.

objective_validator_fields.check: Count distinct declared IDs and uses; reject undeclared references and duplicate IDs; retain cost categories separately.
objective_validator_fields.limit: Semantic atomicity, hidden defaults and opaque whole-branch records require independent manual review; one dictionary entry can hide multiple assumptions.

objective_validator_fields.check: Preserve capacity flags and literal forms independently of author compatibility; alternate coverage counts are checkable.
objective_validator_fields.limit: Compatible alternate readings are not independent physical confirmation or a meaning selector.

claim_ceiling: Exact bounded source/form accounting only; distinct forms and repeats are not lexical meanings, calibrated priors, evidence of relations/events, or confirmation.
